title: Informal Conference and Board Hearing Features by Lane, Decision Reviews and Appeals
content:
### Decision Reviews and Appeals: oral presentation features of each lane

Two lanes of Decision Reviews and Appeals give the claimant a chance to speak to the decision-maker: the Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference, through a telephone informal conference with the senior reviewer, and the Board Appeal - Hearing Docket, through a hearing before a Veterans Law Judge. The schedule states for all six lanes whether each feature exists and on what terms.

#### Informal conference

| Lane | Informal conference held | Conferences per request | What may be raised |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | No | 0 | Not applicable |
| Higher-Level Review | No | 0 | Not applicable |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | Yes | 1 | Specific errors may be identified; no new evidence |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | No | 0 | Not applicable |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | No | 0 | Not applicable |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | No | 0 | Not applicable |

#### Board hearing

| Lane | Hearing before a Veterans Law Judge | Hearing types available | Reschedules allowed for good cause | Transcript placed in the record | Order in which hearings are scheduled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | No | None | 0 | No | Not applicable |
| Higher-Level Review | No | None | 0 | No | Not applicable |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | No | None | 0 | No | Not applicable |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | No | None | 0 | No | Not applicable |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | No | None | 0 | No | Not applicable |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | Yes | Virtual tele-hearing; videoconference; central office | 1 | Yes | Docket order, with appeals advanced on the docket first |

#### Notes

- The informal conference exists only in the Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference, and one conference is held per request. It is limited to identifying specific errors; no new evidence is presented in it.
- The Board hearing exists only on the Hearing Docket. Three hearing types are available: a virtual tele-hearing, a videoconference hearing and a central office hearing. A scheduled hearing may be rescheduled one time for good cause, and a transcript of the hearing is placed in the record.
- Hearings are scheduled in docket order, and appeals advanced on the docket are scheduled first.

#### Basis questions

**Can a claimant in the plain Higher-Level Review lane have an informal conference?** No. The plain Higher-Level Review holds 0 conferences; the conference belongs to the Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference.

**Hypothetical: a Hearing Docket hearing has already been rescheduled once for good cause.** The reschedule allowance on the Hearing Docket is 1, so that allowance has been used.

**Does the Evidence Submission Docket include a hearing?** No. Of the Board dockets, only the Hearing Docket includes a hearing.
